answer_1.quote: The remarkable breakthroughs of large language models (LLMs) on complex reasoning tasks ... are largely attributed to extensive inference-time computation for deep thinking, a paradigm known as "Test-Time Scaling" (TTS).
answer_1.outputs: chain-of-thought reasoning steps and final answers for mathematical and scientific questions

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the reasoning ability of LLMs with three metrics: • Maj@k measures the majority vote correctness from k independently sampled outputs based on self-consistency . • RM@k measures the best solution correctness from k sampled outputs selected by the specific reward model. • Pass@k measures whether at least one of the model's k sampled outputs is correct.

answer_3.quote: OpenAI  later trains a reward model on a larger-scale, human-annotated dataset PRM800K, demonstrating that PRMs outperform ORMs in evaluating reasoning quality.
criteria: logical relationship between current step and preceding context
